attempted_claim: Let X4 be a smooth monotone del Pezzo surface of degree 4 (smooth intersection of two quadrics in CP^4, equivalently CP^2 blown up at 5 points in general position) with monotone symplectic form. Let T_toric be the monotone toric fibre and T_BC be the monotone Biran-Cornea circle-bundle torus over the equator of an exceptional sphere in a fixed blowup presentation, both monotone Lagrangian 2-tori in X4. Prove or disprove: T_toric and T_BC are Hamiltonian isotopic in X4. A complete answer computes Lagrangian Floer homology with rank-one local systems (equivalently the pearl complex with holonomy variables) for both tori and either constructs a Hamiltonian isotopy between them or finds a local system at which the self-Floer cohomologies differ (one vanishing, one nonvanishing), which obstructs Hamiltonian isotopy.
claim_type: Hamiltonian isotopy distinction via local systems
decisive_failure: Exact monotone Maslov-2 disk enumerations for the fixed Bl_5 presentation (toric-descendant coefficients) and the Biran-Cornea fibre disks over the fixed exceptional equator remain underived; the single literature retrieval failed technically and web checks returned no usable formula, so neither a Hamiltonian isotopy nor a distinguishing rank-one local system could be verified within the bounded clock.
